entities.name: Protected coumarin substrate
observations: Contains an ethyl ester, substituted alkene, coumarin-like oxygenated lactone core, and two silyl ethers.
The terminal primary O-silyl ether is selectively converted to a primary alcohol while the aryl O-silyl ether is retained.

entities.name: Selective terminal desilylation
observations: Transformation: -CH2CH2CH2-O-Si... becomes -CH2CH2CH2-OH; the remaining aryl O-silyl group and other functional groups are preserved.
Matched reaction records report approximately 87.7% yield over 10 hours.

entities.name: Acetonitrile solvent
observations: Acetonitrile is classified as solvent and is not incorporated into the product; no acetonitrile-derived atoms appear in the product.

entities.name: Mono-desilylated alcohol product
observations: This is the substrate with the terminal primary silyl ether replaced by -CH2CH2CH2OH.
